description: Changes ONE call to action in the live webinar room: the offer or booking box, its tab name, its body, its button and whether it is shown, or the moment an evergreen webinar reveals it. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Participants see it in the room; nothing else on the campaign changes and no page is rebuilt. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars. Leave `slot` out to ADD a new CTA at the end; name a slot (1, 2, 3) to change exactly that one and leave the others untouched; `copy_from` copies an existing slot first. `timing` is the reveal time as MM:SS for an evergreen webinar. For a WooCommerce offer with product, price and voucher use wi_change_webinar_offer, for a checkout page you want to embed check it first with wi_check_embedding. `remove` deletes the whole slot and cannot be undone, so it needs a clear yes.

button_text.description: The button label. An empty string removes the label, together with button_url it removes the button.

button_url.description: Where the button goes. An empty string removes the link.

confirm.description: Must be true together with remove, and only after the host said that this CTA may be deleted.

copy_from.description: Copy this existing slot first, then apply the other fields on top.

iframe.description: Show the body inside an iframe.

on.description: Show this CTA in the room (true) or hide it (false).

position.description: outer is the sidebar tab on the right, overlay lies over the video.

remove.description: true deletes this whole CTA slot. Cannot be undone, needs the host's clear yes.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

slot.description: Which CTA slot (1, 2, 3). Leave it out to add a new CTA at the end.

tab_text.description: The name of the sidebar tab for this CTA.

text.description: The body of the CTA: HTML or shortcodes, e.g. an [advanced_iframe src="..."] for an embedded page.

timing.description: Evergreen only: when the CTA appears, as MM:SS after the start, e.g. 20:00.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

width.description: Overlay box width, e.g. 60% or 500px (overlay only).

name: wi_change_webinar_cta
title: Change the call to action in the webinar room
